_notes.login: Seeded DEV credentials (README.md / scripts.seed). Defaults point at the hosted AWS demo box (public HTTPS, mock data) so the agent works with nothing local. For local dev, override: PHARMASSIST_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8000 PHARMASSIST_WEBAPP_URL=http://localhost:5173 (needs docker compose up -d backend db).
_notes.scan.interKeyMs: A keystroke burst whose keys arrive within this gap is treated as a scanner (humans type slower). Terminated by Enter.
_notes.scan.sentinelPrefix: PRODUCTION posture: program the Eyoyo with a distinctive prefix and set it here so the hook reacts ONLY to sentinel-framed scans, never general typing. Empty = burst-timing detection (fine for research).
_notes.demo: Your Eyoyo packs are GS1 MEDICINE packs with no prescription attached. mapUnknownToDemo maps any scanned code that isn't an RX id to a demo prescription, deterministically (same pack → same scenario) — so you scan real packs and get a real-feeling safety verdict. Printed RX2024-xxx barcodes (npm run barcodes) still resolve directly. prescriptions[0] is the headliner (Warfarin BLOCK); the list also backs the Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+1..8 hotkeys.
